2609.19585.title: CliniCIRCA: A Modular LLM Framework for Constructing Longitudinal Mental Health Patient Journeys from Raw EHR Narratives
2609.19585.paper_summary: In mental health care, reasoning over patient journeys is a key task for clinicians. Yet these journeys, encompassing a longitudinal progression of biological, psychological, and social events, are often spread across disparate unstructured text narratives, making temporal recovery challenging. We present CliniCIRCA, a multi-stage LLM framework for Calendar-anchored, Imprecision-aware Reconstruction of Clinical Annals. To our knowledge, CliniCIRCA is the first to temporally classify clinical events across unstructured discharge summaries without event-level timestamps. From 14,882 MIMIC-III mental health admissions, we first construct a benchmark of 52 discharge summaries on which CliniCIRCA produces 15,891 temporally tagged events. After correcting 629 errors based on a clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, we produce verified gold-standard labels. Finally, the corrected timelines drive a temporally grounded summarization stage that compresses each source 1.52 times into a date-grouped chronological record. We then scale the framework to generate 1,000 silver-standard timelines and evaluate them as training data. Compared with zero- and few-shot prompting, instruction tuning generally improves five open-weight models on event extraction, temporal tagging, and summarization across silver and clinician-verified evaluations.
2609.19585.paper_summary_zh: 在心理健康護理中，對病人旅程的推理是臨床醫生的一項關鍵任務。<lb/>然而，這些旅程涵蓋了生物、心理和社會事件的長期進展，通常分散在不同的非結構化文本敘事中，使得時間恢復變得具有挑戰性。<lb/>我們提出了CliniCIRCA，一個多階段的LLM框架，用於基於日曆的、考慮不精確性的臨床年鑑重建。<lb/>據我們所知，CliniCIRCA是第一個在沒有事件級時間戳的情況下，對非結構化出院摘要中的臨床事件進行時間分類的系統。<lb/>從14,882例MIMIC-III心理健康住院病例中，我們首先構建了一個基準，包含52份出院摘要，CliniCIRCA在此基準上生成了15,891個時間標記事件。<lb/>在根據臨床醫生參與評估修正629個錯誤後，我們生成了經過驗證的黃金標準標籤。<lb/>最後，修正後的時間線驅動了一個時間基礎的總結階段，將每個來源壓縮1.52倍，形成按日期分組的時間記錄。<lb/>然後，我們擴展該框架以生成1,000個銀標準時間線並將其作為訓練數據進行評估。<lb/>與零樣本和少樣本提示相比，指令調整通常改善了五個開放權重模型在事件提取、時間標記和總結方面的表現，無論是在銀標準還是臨床醫生驗證的評估中。
